description: Test suite for upload-related API endpoints in Mattermost, including upload creation, retrieval, and data upload, with various permission and configuration checks.

methods.name: TestCreateUpload
methods.description: Tests for creating uploads, including permission checks, size limits, cloud restrictions, and filename sanitization.

methods.name: TestGetUpload
methods.description: Tests for retrieving upload sessions by ID, including not found, permission denied, and success cases.

methods.name: TestGetUploadsForUser
methods.description: Tests for listing uploads for a user, including permission checks and empty results.

methods.name: TestUploadData
methods.description: Tests for uploading file data, including permission checks, size validation, cloud restrictions, and resumable uploads.

methods.name: TestUploadDataMultipart
methods.description: Tests for uploading file data via multipart form, including validation and resumable uploads.
